## About

This repository contains **structured threat intelligence reports** produced by [TI Mindmap HUB](https://ti-mindmap-hub.com), an independent research platform applying Generative AI to Cyber Threat Intelligence workflows.

Each report synthesizes multiple OSINT sources into a single, structured assessment that includes:

- 📝 Executive summary and technical analysis
- 🎯 Threat actor profiles and attribution
- 🗺️ MITRE ATT&CK technique mapping
- 🔍 Extracted Indicators of Compromise (IOCs)
- 📦 STIX 2.1 bundle highlights
- 🔓 CVE analysis with EPSS scores
- 📊 Interactive HTML dashboards (where applicable)

## Report Structure

Each report follows a consistent format:

```
report.md
├── Frontmatter (YAML)      # Title, date, severity, tags, source count
├── Source Reports Table     # All analyzed sources with links
├── Executive Summary        # Overview, attack diagrams, attribution
├── Technical Details        # Malware analysis, infrastructure, attack phases
├── Detection Opportunities  # SIGMA rules, behavioral detections, network indicators
├── Conclusion               # Key takeaways and recommendations
├── Indicators of Compromise # IPs, domains, hashes, file paths, packages
└── MITRE ATT&CK Mapping    # Full technique table with tactic and description
```

### Interactive Dashboards

Select reports include an **HTML dashboard** (`*-dashboard.html`) with:
- SVG world map with threat actor geolocation
- Sector threat level visualization
- IOC chip display for quick copy
- MITRE ATT&CK heatmap
- Attack flow diagrams
- Event timeline

> Open `.html` files directly in a browser — no dependencies required.

---



### Extracting IOCs

Each report contains a dedicated IOC section. IOCs are defanged using standard notation:

| Format | Example |
|--------|---------|
| IPv4 | `192.168.1[.]1` |
| Domain | `malicious[.]com` |
| URL | `http://evil[.]com/payload` |
| SHA256 | Full 64-character hash |
| Email | `actor@proton[.]me` |

### Importing to SIEM/TIP

1. Extract IOCs from the report's IOC section
2. Refang indicators (remove `[.]` brackets)
3. Import into your platform (Splunk, Sentinel, MISP, OpenCTI, etc.)

For structured STIX 2.1 bundles, visit [ti-mindmap-hub.com](https://ti-mindmap-hub.com).

## Classification

All reports in this repository are classified **TLP:WHITE** — information may be distributed freely, without restriction.

| Label | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| **TLP:WHITE** | No restrictions on disclosure |
| **OSINT** | Derived exclusively from publicly available sources |

> TI Mindmap HUB does not generate, fabricate, or independently verify threat claims. Reports structure and synthesize information already in the public domain.

## Repository Structure

```
ti-mindmap-hub-reports/
├── README.md                # This file
├── reports/                 # All threat intelligence reports
│   ├── YYYY-MM-DD-*.md      # Markdown reports
│   └── YYYY-MM-DD-*.html    # Interactive dashboards
├── schemas/                 # STIX 2.1 examples
│   └── stix-examples/
└── LICENSE                  # CC BY-NC 4.0
```

### Naming Convention

```
YYYY-MM-DD-short-description.md
```

Examples:
- `2026-04-03-iran-conflict-cyber-threat-escalation.md`
- `2026-03-31-axios-npm-supply-chain-attack.md`
- `2026-04-06-threat-dashboard.html`
